item.title: Publishing Briefs: Sofi Tukker Launches Animal Talk Publishing With Third Side Music
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music plays in the background]
Host: "Hey there, music lovers! Today, we're talking about the exciting new venture between electronic duo Sofi Tukker and Third Side Music. The duo, made up of Sophie Hawley-Weld and Tucker Halpern, has just launched Animal Talk Publishing, a joint venture with Third Side Music.
[Music transitions to a soft, pulsing beat]
Host: "But that's not all - Third Side Music has also signed an exclusive worldwide publishing administration deal with Sofi Tukker. This is a big deal, especially considering the duo has been working with Third Side Music for over a decade. In fact, Brontë Jane, executive VP of A&R at Third Side Music, first signed Sofi Tukker 10 years ago and has been working with them ever since.
[Clip of Sofi Tukker's music plays briefly]
Host: "According to Brontë Jane, Sofi Tukker is a true example of a career artist, valuing longevity and creative expression. And with this new venture, they're taking it to the next level. Sofi Tukker themselves said it's rare to work with the same team for so long, but Third Side Music has been consistently amazing for them.
[Music transitions back to the upbeat tune]
Host: "Since signing with Third Side Music in 2017, Sofi Tukker has landed over 450 synch placements. That's huge! And now, with Animal Talk Publishing, they're looking to pay it forward and bring other artists into the Third Side Music family.
[Music fades out]
Host: "That's all for today, folks. Big congrats to Sofi Tukker and Third Side Music on this exciting new venture. We can't wait to see what's next for this talented duo!"
